later.en: He was rushed to hospital, but he didn’t make it; he died 18 days later.
later.zh: 他被紧急送往医院，但没能挺过去；18 天后他去世了。

later.en: I'm going to say 50%. Well, we'll find out the answer later in the programme.
later.zh: 我猜是 50%。好，我们稍后将在节目中揭晓答案。

later.en: Ooh, I don't know... Maybe JD Vance? We'll find out later in the programme.
later.zh: 哦，我不知道……也许是詹姆斯·戴维·万斯？我们稍后在节目中揭晓。

later.en: Its citizens fought alongside Britain in World War I and later World War II.
later.zh: 其公民与英国并肩作战，参加了第一次世界大战和后来的第二次世界大战。

later.en: But two years later, he and the gunfight would be brought back to life.
later.zh: 但两年后，他和那场枪战都将被重新唤醒，再度“活”了过来。

labour.en: Earlier in his career, he was associated with Labour’s more moderate or center-right side.
labour.zh: 在他职业生涯的早期，他曾与工党偏温和或中右翼的一派联系紧密。

labour.en: Labour has a large majority in Parliament and Britain is not holding an election.
labour.zh: 工党在议会中拥有多数席位，而且英国目前没有举行大选。

labour.en: The north was industrial, factories, mines, dominated by manual labour.
labour.zh: 北方是工业化的，布满了工厂、矿井，以体力劳动为主。

labour.en: And the leader of the Labour Party, the leader of the opposition, is a man called Keir Starmer.
labour.zh: 工党领袖、反对党领袖是一个叫 Keir Starmer 的人。

labour.en: There would be no pollution, no child labour, and no destruction of forests to make way for the mines.
labour.zh: 那样就不会有污染，没有童工，也不会为了腾出矿区而破坏森林。

law.en: To many ordinary people, the old elite had lived above the law for decades.
law.zh: 对许多普通人来说，老一代精英几十年来一直凌驾于法律之上。

law.en: In other words, US citizens can do it, according to US law at least.
law.zh: 换句话说，至少根据美国法律，美国公民可以这么做。

law.en: It explains the government’s plans and their intentions, but it’s not a law yet.
law.zh: 它阐述了政府的计划和意图，但还不是法律。

law.en: It repealed the law completely, cancelling it as if it had never existed.
law.zh: 它彻底废除了这项法律，将其取消，就好像它从未存在过一样。

law.en: But the community was divided. Half of Tombstone saw the Earps as law enforcers.
law.zh: 但小镇上的民众意见分裂。有一半人把 Earp 兄弟视为执法者。

launch.en: In the early 1900s, Mayor Pereira Passos launched a program to renew the city.
launch.zh: 20世纪初，佩雷拉·帕索斯市长发起了一项改造城市的计划。

launch.en: Some countries launched major advertising campaigns encouraging citizens to vote for their national monument.
launch.zh: 一些国家发起大型广告活动，鼓励公民为本国古迹投票。

launch.en: Instead, he was about to launch what would become the Turkish War of Independence.
launch.zh: 相反，他即将发起后来被称为土耳其独立战争的运动。

launch.en: When Vance launched his political career, Thiel provided much of the financial backing.
launch.zh: 当 Vance 开启自己的政治生涯时，蒂尔提供了大量的资金支持。

launch.en: Despite the countless expeditions launched to uncover the truth, Fawcett’s remains have never been identified.
launch.zh: 尽管为了揭开真相发起了无数次远征，Fawcett 的遗骸却从未被确认过。

landscape.en: In 2012, UNESCO recognized parts of Rio’s landscape as a World Heritage Site.
landscape.zh: 2012年，联合国教科文组织将里约的部分景观认定为世界遗产。

landscape.en: Mountains rose, oceans retreated and landscapes were shaped by these slow processes.
landscape.zh: 山脉隆起，海洋退去，地貌正是由这些缓慢的过程塑造的。

landscape.en: Humans were nomadic hunter-gatherers, moving across the landscape in small groups.
landscape.zh: 人类是游牧猎人，成群结队地在广袤的大地上迁徙。

landscape.en: They hunted. They guarded. They herded. They pulled sleds across frozen landscapes where no other animals could.
landscape.zh: 它们狩猎。它们看家。它们放牧。它们在没有任何其他动物能够涉足的冰冻大地上拉雪橇。

landscape.en: No, no, no. My inner landscape would be solved by skirting around the most well-known wisdom of the ages.
landscape.zh: 不，不，不。我的内心世界可以通过绕过那些众所周知的古老智慧来解决。

lap.en: It's not easy. It's not going to fall in your lap and you have to learn something and know something and do something interesting.
lap.zh: 这并不容易。它不会从天上掉下来，你必须学习一些东西，了解一些东西，做出一些有趣的事情。

lap.en: Sometimes – and I know this could be, like, picky for everyone else – but having a tissue or napkin on your lap just in case you spill anything.
lap.zh: 有时——我知道这对其他人来说可能有点挑剔——但在腿上放一张纸巾或餐巾，以防弄脏衣服。

lap.en: Yeah, yeah, I saw that. and I'm in a boot and I've got the laptop on my lap and we've created this arm that'll bring the mic to me because I didn't want to stop doing the podcast because I'd made this commitment.
lap.zh: 没错，我看到了。我穿着护具，腿上放着笔记本电脑，我们做了一个支架把麦克风送到我面前，因为我不想停止做播客，因为我做出了承诺。

layer.en: It's just a piece of predestination with human agency layered on top of it.
layer.zh: 这不过是在一部分“注定”的基础上，叠加了人的能动性。

layer.en: And this was layered on top of the sexual depravity.
layer.zh: 而这一切还叠加在性堕落之上。

layer.en: It takes years of training, a truly exceptional sense of smell, and an ability to create complex, layered compositions.
layer.zh: 这需要多年的训练、真正卓越的嗅觉，以及创造复杂、多层香调组合的能力。

layer.en: And that thing, that base layer of being, and this is what the Buddhists will tell you, is the real thing.
layer.zh: 而那个东西，那个存在的底层——这就是佛教徒会告诉你的——才是真实的东西。

layer.en: Here, the seasoning is multiple, multiple layers.
layer.zh: 在这里，调味是多层叠加的。

label.en: The managers brought us up to New York to play for the major record labels.
label.zh: 经纪人们把我们带到纽约去为各大唱片公司演出。

label.en: But as we will discover, the story is a great deal more complicated than that label suggests.
label.zh: 但正如我们将要了解到的那样，事实远比这个标签所暗示的要复杂得多。

label.en: It's a form of therapy. And so I think because we've given it this, like the label people, I go to therapy.
label.zh: 这是一种心理咨询。所以我认为，因为我们给它贴上了标签，人们会说‘我去心理咨询’。

label.en: For these parties, citizenship is not simply an administrative label, a matter of residency, or a tool to secure economic growth.
label.zh: 对这些政党而言，公民身份不仅仅是一个行政标签、居住地的问题，或是促进经济增长的工具。

label.en: It had thirty switches, each labelled with a voltage: 15 volts at the lower end, up to 450 volts at the higher end.
label.zh: 上面有三十个开关，每个开关都标注着对应的电压：低端是15伏特，高端一直到450伏特。

largely.en: She did all of this at a time when women were largely excluded from science.
largely.zh: 她所有这一切都是在女性被大面积排除在科学界之外的时期完成的。

largely.en: Hannibal’s initial hope, that Rome’s allies would rise up and join him, had largely not transpired.
largely.zh: Hannibal最初的希望——即罗马的同盟会起义加入他——大部分并没有实现。

largely.en: Beyond that, they were largely left to figure things out for themselves.
largely.zh: 除此之外，基本上就靠他们自己摸索了。

largely.en: Under Ottoman rule, women had been largely excluded from public life.
largely.zh: 在奥斯曼统治下，女性基本上被排除在公共生活之外。

largely.en: For many years, however, Turing received little public recognition, largely because his wartime work remained secret.
largely.zh: 然而多年来，Turing 几乎没有获得公众的认可，很大程度上是因为他的战时工作仍然属于机密。

lawyer.en: She was the daughter of Indian immigrants and was herself a highly accomplished lawyer.
lawyer.zh: 她是印度移民的女儿，本身就是一位极有成就的律师。

lawyer.en: Your lawyer tells you to expect your case to come to court in approximately three years.
lawyer.zh: 你的律师告诉你，你的案子大概要等上三年左右才能开庭。

lawyer.en: You go be a lawyer, 40-year cycle. These are very long cycles.
lawyer.zh: 你去当律师，40 年周期。这些都是非常长的周期。

lawyer.en: His lawyers wanted to argue that he was mentally ill and therefore not responsible for his actions.
lawyer.zh: 他的律师想辩称他患有精神疾病，因此不承担责任。

lawyer.en: They might be former politicians, scientists, lawyers, businesspeople, campaigners, or academics.
lawyer.zh: 他们可能是前政客、科学家、律师、商界人士、活动家或学者。

laboratory.en: Jack came out of a more traditional intelligence laboratory, but had now turned his attention to mood and emotion.
laboratory.zh: 杰克出身于一个更传统的智力研究实验室，但当时已经把研究方向转向了心境和情绪。

laboratory.en: These schools are supposed to be laboratories of great teaching, places where some of the rules and regulations of regular public schools don't apply.
laboratory.zh: 这些学校本应是卓越教学的实验室，在这里，常规公立学校的一些规章制度不再适用。

laboratory.en: This is what Hannah Arendt believed she had seen in Eichmann, and it is what Milgram said he had demonstrated in a laboratory.
laboratory.zh: 这正是汉娜·阿伦特认为自己在艾希曼身上看到的东西，也正是米尔格拉姆声称自己在实验室里证明了的东西。

laboratory.en: When the volunteers arrived at the psychology department at Yale, they were met by a man in a grey laboratory coat who explained the study.
laboratory.zh: 志愿者抵达耶鲁大学心理学系后，会有一位身穿灰色实验服的男子接待他们，向他们讲解这项研究。

laboratory.en: From the ancient temples of Mesopotamia to the laboratories of modern perfumers, from the rarest natural ingredients to the synthetic molecules designed to mimic them, perfume is much more than just a pleasant smell.
laboratory.zh: 从美索不达米亚的古代神庙到现代调香师的实验室，从最稀有的天然成分到旨在模仿它们的合成分子，香水远不止是一种令人愉悦的气味。

layout.en: A layout built around the idea that the master and matron could see everything, and that inmates knew there was nowhere to hide.
layout.zh: 这种布局的建立是基于这样的理念：主管和女管家可以看到一切，而囚禁者知道无处可藏。

layout.en: It's the layout we're all really, really used to though, and if you see court reporters, stenographers, they have special keyboards and can type so fast to takedown verbatim, but they also look very complicated, I don't actually want to learn to use one of those so I'll stick with QWERTY for the moment.
layout.zh: 不过这也是我们大家真的、真的习惯了的布局，如果你看到法庭速记员，他们有特殊的键盘，能够以极快的速度逐字记录，但它们看起来也很复杂，我其实不想去学用那种键盘，所以我暂时还是坚持用QWERTY键盘吧。

layout.en: Here, Chris Vallance, presenter of BBC World Service’s, Tech Life, discusses a similar example with Dr Tacye Phillipson, science curator at the National Museum of Scotland: Another piece of tech that people say has sort of refused to die is the QWERTY keyboard, the layout of keyboards that we all have, and is perhaps not the most efficient layout in terms of the speed of typing.
layout.zh: 在这里，BBC世界服务部Tech Life的主持人Chris Vallance与苏格兰国家博物馆的科学策展人Tacye Phillipson博士讨论了一个类似的例子：人们说另一种有点“死不退场”的技术是QWERTY键盘，也就是我们大家都在用的键盘布局，从打字速度来看，它或许并不是最高效的布局。

lay.en: And Marie Curie… her discoveries laid the foundations for so many other things.
lay.zh: 而玛丽·居里……她的发现为如此之多的其他领域奠定了基础。

lay.en: Claude Shannon laid the intellectual foundations for much of the digital revolution.
lay.zh: 克劳德·香农为数字革命的大部分理论奠定了基础。

lay.en: And she conducted experiments that laid the foundation for nuclear physics, chemistry, and medical treatments.
lay.zh: 她进行的实验为核物理学、化学和医学治疗奠定了基础。

lay.en: But he quickly discovered that his talents lay beyond conventional soldiering.
lay.zh: 但他很快发现，自己的才能并不在常规的军旅生涯中。

lay.en: For in the destructive potential of the atomic bomb lay opportunity.
lay.zh: 因为在原子弹的毁灭潜力中，蕴含着机遇。

laughter.en: Authenticity is contagious. (Laughter) I have been dragged into this all the way kicking and screaming.
laughter.zh: 真实具有传染性。（笑声）我是一直被连拖带拽地拉进来的，又踢又叫。

laughter.en: And the audience, at least most of the time, roars with laughter.
laughter.zh: 而观众，至少在大多数时候，都会爆发出大笑。

laughter.en: On some days, we get to leave at 4 p.m. Some days, we don't leave till 1 a.m. (Laughter).
laughter.zh: 有时候我们可以下午4点下班。有时我们直到凌晨1点才离开。（笑声）。

laughter.en: At one dinner party in ancient Rome, hosted by the then-emperor, Caligula, the host burst out in raucous laughter.
laughter.zh: 在古罗马的一场晚宴上，由当时的皇帝 Caligula 主办，主人突然爆发出一阵粗鲁刺耳的大笑。

laughter.en: Perhaps you can think of a dinner party you’ve been to where someone around the table burst out in uncontrollable laughter.
laughter.zh: 也许你能想到自己去过的某场晚宴，席间有人突然爆发出一阵无法控制的笑声。

landlord.en: The key seems to be balancing tenant protection with incentives to keep landlords in the market.
landlord.zh: 关键似乎在于平衡租客保护与激励房东留在市场上的动力。

landlord.en: The economic rationale for this is pretty obvious; a landlord can typically make much more money.
landlord.zh: 背后的经济逻辑相当明显；房东通常能赚到更多钱。

ladder.en: If your parents own property, you might still get on the ladder, as the expression goes.
ladder.zh: 如果你的父母拥有房产，正如俗话所说，你或许还能挤上这趟阶梯。

ladder.en: According to a recent biography, as a teenager he showed little ambition or interest in climbing the royal ladder.
ladder.zh: 根据最近的一本传记，他在青少年时期几乎没有什么野心，也对攀登王室阶梯不感兴趣。

ladder.en: There were other ones-- Property Ladder, Designed to Sell.
ladder.zh: 还有其他的节目——《房地产梯子》（Property Ladder）、《设计待售》（Designed to Sell）。

ladder.en: Yeah, that one's harder to climb the ladder on.
ladder.zh: 是的，那个榜单想要往上爬更难。

ladder.en: And clearly, since we are all collectively far, far wealthier than we were in hunter-gatherer times. uh wealth creation is positive but status is limited there's limited status to go around it's a ranking ladder it's a hierarchy and so to rise in status somebody else has a lower in status now you can have multiple kinds of status so you can expand some kinds of status but it's not like wealth creation where it can go infinitely where we can all be you know living in the stars and moon bases or mars colonies or what have you so just realize the status games are inherently limited.
ladder.zh: 显然，既然我们集体比猎人采集时代要富裕得多得多，财富创造是正和的，但地位是有限的。可供争夺的地位是有限的，它是一个排名阶梯，是一个等级制度。因此，为了提升地位，势必有人的地位会下降。虽然你可以拥有多种地位，所以你可以扩展某些种类的地位，但这不像财富创造那样可以无限发展，我们可以全部生活在星空、月球基地或火星殖民地等等地方。所以，只要意识到地位游戏本质上是有限的。

landing.en: So I looked at every single page to head, every landing page, every offer, every everything.
landing.zh: 所以我看了每一个页面，每一个登陆页面，每一个报价，每一个东西。

landing.en: Constitution, the French Revolution, and even the moon landing.
landing.zh: 宪法、法国大革命，甚至是登月。

landing.en: It jumped across the landing and down the stairs.
landing.zh: 它跳过平台，顺着楼梯跑了下去。

landing.en: To quote Putin directly, 'There, on that stair landing, I got a quick and lasting lesson in the meaning of the word "cornered".
landing.zh: 用普京的原话来说：“在那里的楼梯平台上，我上了一堂生动而持久的课，明白了‘走投无路’这个词的真正含义。”

landing.en: One of his early devices was planted on an American Airlines flight, causing smoke to fill the cabin and nearly forcing an emergency landing.
landing.zh: 他早期的装置之一被安放在一架美国航空公司的航班上，导致浓烟弥漫机舱，差点逼迫飞机紧急迫降。

lab.en: Not a lab, but as the two were painting Peter's living room.
lab.zh: 不是在实验室里，而是在他们两人一起粉刷彼得家客厅的时候。

lab.en: But while these methods can be incredibly precise in a lab, they’re expensive, invasive, and not exactly practical for large populations.
lab.zh: 但虽然这些方法在实验室里可以做到极其精准，它们价格昂贵、具有侵入性，对于庞大的人口基数来说并不切实际。

lab.en: We did a study in which you came to the lab as a participant in research and had to interact with a stranger.
lab.zh: 我们做过一项研究，让参与者来到实验室，与一位陌生人互动。

lab.en: And then, you go back again to AT&T, Bell Labs, and this notion that Bell Labs was possibly the greatest single institution responsible for invention in human history.
lab.zh: 然后再往前追溯，就会回到AT&T、贝尔实验室，以及这样一种说法——贝尔实验室可能是人类历史上单个最伟大的发明机构。

lab.en: And then, you go back again to AT&T, Bell Labs, and this notion that Bell Labs was possibly the greatest single institution responsible for invention in human history.
lab.zh: 然后再往前追溯，就会回到AT&T、贝尔实验室，以及这样一种说法——贝尔实验室可能是人类历史上单个最伟大的发明机构。

lawsuit.en: A lawsuit was filed on February 3rd, alleging that DOGE’s access to the Treasury’s systems violated federal privacy laws.
lawsuit.zh: 2 月 3 日提起了一起诉讼，指控 DOGE 访问财政部系统的行为违反了联邦隐私法。

lawsuit.en: There's no course of action for a lawsuit.

layoff.en: But he felt a layoff was different. He was mad that she'd made a stupid mistake.
layoff.zh: 但他觉得裁员情况不同。他很生气她犯了这么蠢的错误。

layoff.en: And then there were the layoffs. DOGE didn’t just want to modernise technology; it wanted to shrink the federal workforce dramatically.
layoff.zh: 接下来就是裁员。DOGE 不仅想实现技术现代化；它还想大幅缩减联邦员工队伍。

latitude.en: Undeterred by this incredibly hostile territory, he would calmly record latitudes and longitudes in areas where few outsiders had ever ventured.
latitude.zh: 在这片极其恶劣的土地上，他毫不气馁，在极少有外来者涉足的地区冷静地记录着经纬度。

laser.en: Perhaps it would be lasers that would vaporise material, robotic arms that grind and collect it, or even specialised bacteria, as they do in terrestrial biomining, that break down rock and release valuable metals like nickel or cobalt.
laser.zh: 也许会使用激光来汽化物质，用机械臂来研磨和收集，或者甚至像地面生物浸出那样使用特殊的细菌来分解岩石并释放出镍或钴等有价值的金属。

lamb.en: Traditionally, this is eaten on Sundays, hence the name, and it involves roasted meat, chicken, pork, lamb, beef, sometimes other things like turkey as well potatoes, vegetables, gravy, Yorkshire pudding.
lamb.zh: 传统上，这道菜在周日食用，因此得名，它包括烤肉（鸡肉、猪肉、羊肉、牛肉，有时也有火鸡等其他肉类）、土豆、蔬菜、肉汁和约克郡布丁。

lamp.en: When cameras are visible on buildings or on lamp posts, they can discourage criminal behavior.
lamp.zh: 当摄像头显眼地安装在建筑物上或电线杆上时，它们可以起到威慑犯罪行为的作用。

lane.en: I didn’t really know the vocabulary for terms like lanes or mirrors or traffic laws.
lane.zh: 我真的不知道车道、后视镜或交通法规等术语怎么说。

lane.en: Terms for the “road”, terms for “lanes”, terms for the “shoulder” at the edge of a road.
lane.zh: 关于“道路”的术语，“车道”的术语，路边缘“路肩”的术语。

lame.en: I think it's that you're right thing, which is someone says, that's lame, that sucks, blah, blah, blah.
lame.zh: 我认为这就是那个“你是对的”的事情，即有人说“那很烂，那很糟糕，巴拉巴拉”。

lame.en: Why are you doing that? That's lame. That's for losers.
lame.zh: 你为什么要那样做？那很烂。那是给失败者做的。

lame.en: For instance, a president in the final months of their term might be called a lame duck because Congress and the public pay less attention to their decisions.
lame.zh: 例如，处于任期最后几个月的总统可能会被称为跛脚鸭，因为国会和公众对他们的决策关注度会下降。

lame.en: A lame duck is not a bird that can’t fly, but a lame duck is an elected official whose power is weakened because they will soon leave office.
lame.zh: “跛脚鸭”（lame duck）可不是指不会飞的鸟，而是一位权力被削弱的民选官员，因为他们即将离任。

latter.en: I'm sure I've been more affected by things that happened in my latter years because I was more aware of them.
latter.zh: 我相信我后来受到的影响更大，因为我更了解这些事情。

lag.en: No, it might not be the same that way. But just thinking about it as an indicator that the hate is actually the light that you're on the right path. we spoke about this last time that nothing is going to be worthwhile that doesn't come with an associated amount of discomfort therefore when you start to feel friends around you and the people that you used to be able to speak a common language with start to push back and start to make the quips of oh not drinking tonight yeah oh you must be too cool for us now i know it hurts I know it hurts that is the lead indicator not even the lagging indicator that is the lead indicator that you are doing the right thing and lots of people listen to this podcast I get messages from people like hey man I'm a 22 year old rugby player from the northwest of the UK I live in Cumbria none of my friends understand me I want to do personal growth I don't want to live in the UK and when I listen to modern wisdom I feel less alone and it makes me tear up because I'm like fuck I see me in that person I see me in that.
lag.zh: 不，可能不完全是那样。但只要把它看作一个指标，说明仇恨实际上是你走在正确道路上的光。我们上次谈到过，没有任何值得做的事情是不伴随着一定程度的不适的。因此，当你开始感觉到周围的朋友，那些你曾经能用共同语言交流的人开始反击，开始说些俏皮话，比如：哦，今晚不喝酒了？哦，你现在一定觉得我们配不上你了。我知道这很痛，我知道这很痛，但那是领先指标，甚至不是滞后指标，那是你正在做正确事情的领先指标。很多人听这个播客，我收到人们的消息说：嘿，伙计，我是来自英国西北部的一名22岁橄榄球运动员，我住在坎布里亚，我的朋友们都不理解我。我想进行个人成长，我不想住在英国。当我听《Modern Wisdom》时，我感到不那么孤独了。这让我热泪盈眶，因为我心想：该死，我在那个人身上看到了我自己。

laundry.en: Kind of this laundry list of, these are sins that will get you killed.
laundry.zh: 就像是一长串清单，列举了这些会让你丧命的罪过。

laundry.en: She's the one that does laundry for them, and that's it.
laundry.zh: 她负责帮他们洗衣服，就是这样。

laundry.en: I went straight to Walmart and I bought, like, a family size of toilet paper, family size of laundry detergent.
laundry.zh: 我直接去了沃尔玛，买了一大包家庭装的卫生纸，家庭装的洗衣液。
